binary.note: A clean rebuild of the same source can produce different bytes because the release build uses LTO; the hash identifies the shipped artifact for this run, while verification rests on the tests and the session below.

scope: Only the zh-CN recogniser installed on this machine was exercised; no English engine is installed and none was downloaded.
All audio is synthesised by SAPI into a temporary directory and deleted afterwards; no microphone is opened and no user recording or training data is read.

The phone comparison is verified with real engine output and real PowerShell learning output, but the phones-only branch cannot be reached end to end because the closed grammar only ever yields the text of a loaded rule.
The ten-minute session runs the release binary on a synthetic stream; its timing is measured from process start to exit on one PID.

problem.symptom: A variant learned by the PowerShell host stored IPA, while the listener compared SAPI phone ids rendered through ISpPhoneConverter::IdToPhone, which returns pinyin. The two representations could never be equal, so a learned variant could only ever match by its text.
problem.storedFormat: System.Speech Pronunciation -> IPA such as nihaʊhuɕjaʊjɑŋ

converter.engine: Microsoft Speech Recognizer 8.0 for Windows (Chinese Simplified - PRC)
converter.normalisation: FormD, then drop combining marks and whitespace, then lower case — the same steps resources/voice-wake.ps1 applies through [System.Text.NormalizationForm]::FormD and \p{M}\s

learnedVariant.source: resources/voice-wake.ps1 mode=learn through spawn, three samples of homophone.wav, phrase 你好胡晓阳

rust.name: matching::tests::converts_engine_phones_to_the_stored_ipa_form
rust.proves: matching::phones(real UPS text) == real PowerShell phones

rust.name: matching::tests::wakes_on_a_learned_variant_through_phones_alone
rust.proves: with an empty phrase and a variant whose text differs, the real UPS text still wakes; clearing the phones turns the same input into Ignore, so the text branch took no part

rust.name: speech::tests::converts_recognised_phone_ids_to_the_stored_ipa
rust.proves: the production converter chain (SpPhoneticAlphabetConverter + SetLangId + SAPI2UPS + matching::phones) turns the real ids into the stored IPA

rust.name: matching::tests::accepts_a_trained_variant_by_its_text
rust.proves: a trained variant still matches by text when the pronunciation is not involved

electron.name: accepts the variants the PowerShell host learned, pronunciation included
electron.proves: the PowerShell host really learns phones == nihaʊhuɕjaʊjɑŋ and the Rust listener wakes on exactly those variants

harness.name: phone_only.cjs
harness.finding: With a phrase and a variant text that the audio cannot produce, no rule yields a candidate at all, so the phones branch is unreachable end to end. This is a property of the closed grammar, not of the conversion; the branch is therefore proven where the engine output is real and the text targets are removed.

corpus.generator: SAPI Microsoft Huihui Desktop, 16 kHz / 16 bit / mono

longSession.input: 600 s of silence, then complete.wav, 5 s, unrelated.wav, 5 s, complete.wav, 3 s, streamed in real time through the custom IStream on one process
longSession.lateNegative: unrelated.wav between the two wakes produced no wake

resources.trend: private memory and handle count stay flat across the ten minute session

limits: The phones-only branch is proven with real engine ids and real learning output, but not through a full recognition session, because the closed grammar cannot produce a text outside its rules.
English is untested: this machine has no English recognition engine and no language pack was downloaded.
Real speech, hot-plugged microphones, RDP sessions, lock screen and UAC boundaries remain untested.
The ten-minute session uses the stream input; the device input shares the same reader and tracker but was only exercised in short sessions.
